args.title: Add name/search filtering to GET /reports
args.body:
File: src/api/reports.ts

Add an optional name/search query parameter to the GET /reports handler (alongside parsePage) and pass it through to reportRepo.list. This also requires a WHERE name ILIKE clause in src/db/repos/reportRepo.ts so the reports list page can filter by name instead of only paging through all reports.

args.title: Return non-200 status for degraded readiness checks
args.body:
File: src/api/health.ts

The readiness handler maps status to HTTP code with `res.status(status === "down" ? 503 : 200)`, so a 'degraded' queue state still returns 200. Update the status-to-HTTP-code mapping so 'degraded' also returns a distinct non-200 (probe-distinguishable) response instead of 200.

args.title: Respect q-weights when picking locale from Accept-Language
args.body:
File: src/i18n/index.ts

pickLocale currently returns the first comma-separated entry in the Accept-Language header whose language prefix is supported, ignoring the ";q=" weight. Update it to parse the q-weight for each entry and select the supported locale with the highest weight instead.

args.title: Reject non-numeric trailing characters in config int() parsing
args.body:
File: src/config.ts

The `int()` helper uses `Number.parseInt(raw, 10)`, which silently truncates values like "12h" to 12 instead of rejecting them. Replace the validation with a strict check (e.g. `Number(raw)` combined with `Number.isInteger`, or a regex test) so malformed values such as TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES=12h throw the "must be an integer" error at startup instead of being silently accepted.

This explains the 400 'validation failed' response users currently see without documented cause.

This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The `int()` helper in config.ts uses `Number.parseInt(raw, 10)`, which stops at the first non-digit character and silently parses values like "12h" as 12 instead of rejecting them.
